method: Bounded review of the exact103 bundled Roman Psalm citations. Source-native numbered Italian clauses were compared independently with the appointed Standard units, using the pinned Hebrew Psalm appointment evidence and reviewed English/Vulgate source units as references. Chapter counts alone were not used to infer boundaries. Explicit splits/merges below retain complete original source rows and native labels. This does not unlock arbitrary Martini Psalm citations or claim a complete book-wide crosswalk.

publishedWholeChapters.publisherDescription: The publisher identifies its static chapter payloads as the integral Martini Bible text. Native row labels and wording remain the publisher’s own; no within-chapter verse offset is inferred.

chapterIdentityEvidence.nativeOpening: Salmo di Davidde. Il Signore mi governa, e niuna cosa a me mancherà:

publishedWholeChapters.policy: Complete published source chapters may supply only a request covering their complete verified Standard body unit groups. A partial request uses only independently reviewed source-verse boundary facts; missing facts remain unavailable. Full chapter words stay untouched even when native row labels split/merge traditional verses.
